features.name: normalized_plas
features.description: Standardized plasma glucose level to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the plasma glucose feature from dominating Euclidean distance computations due to its larger raw scale.

features.name: normalized_mass
features.description: Standardized body mass index to prevent scale dominance in Euclidean distance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aligns the variance of BMI with other physiological measurements, improving neighborhood geometry.

features.name: normalized_age
features.description: Standardized age to align variance with other physiological measurements for KNN.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures age contributes proportionally to similarity scores without overshadowing smaller-scale features.

features.name: elevated_metrics_cluster
features.description: Binary indicator of co-occurring elevated glucose, BMI, and blood pressure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a distinct spatial cluster for records with multiple elevated physiological metrics, aiding local neighborhood formation.

features.name: distance_to_low_value_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype with low physiological measurements.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous similarity metric to a fixed reference point, anchoring the feature space.

features.name: distance_to_high_value_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype with high physiological measurements.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a secondary spatial anchor, allowing the KNN model to triangulate positions based on multiple reference profiles.

features.name: insulin_glucose_ratio
features.description: Ratio of insulin to glucose, capturing non-linear metabolic relationships.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes a physiological interaction that might be hidden in raw Euclidean space, improving distance-based similarity.

features.name: pedi_age_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between genetic pedigree function and age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Expands the feature space to account for the compounding effect of age and hereditary factors on similarity.

features.name: missing_value_indicator_count
features.description: Count of zero values across physiological columns, which likely represent missing data.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups structurally similar incomplete records closer together in the distance space.

features.name: log_insulin
features.description: Log-transformed insulin levels to compress the long tail of the distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents extreme insulin values from disproportionately inflating distances between otherwise similar neighbors.

features.name: physiological_stress_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of physiological stress based on the combination of glucose, blood pressure, BMI, and age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, non-linear similarity metric that captures complex physiological states better than raw distances.

features.name: hereditary_factor_assessment
features.description: Semantic assessment of hereditary factors based on the pedigree function and number of pregnancies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain knowledge about genetic predisposition into a continuous score, refining neighborhood definitions.
